evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jeline: 'I'm actually calling because we received your request for an estimate for your move on October 26th and I'm just gonna ask you questions and this would take ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So is this a good time to talk about your move?' — frames the time-box but no explicit promise of a dependable quote; customer says 'uh-huh, yeah' but no clear affirmation of the full framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jeline: 'before I discuss the pricing and the estimate with you. Do you have any concerns about the moving process.' — asked after extensive probing (floor, distance, box count, appliances, TV specs, bed frame, destination property details). Manuel replies: 'No, not really.'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Manuel Hernandez), moving day (October 26th), route (5755 Meter Road, Houston 77004 to 118 Tutoring Street, Houston 77007), size (1000 sq ft apartment pickup; 2300 sq ft townhome destination). All four present.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment and townhome), floor/stories (5th floor apartment, 3-story townhome), number of rooms (1 bedroom apartment, 3 bedrooms townhome), walking distances (30 ft parking to elevator, 15-20 ft elevator to unit; 15 ft driveway to front door), special considerations (balcony mentioned, 65-inch TV, wood bed frame to be disassembled, no heavy equipment), box count (25-35 range typical, customer estimates ~20-whatever).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jeline: 'for your move since we're coming from a fifth floor with elevator access, going to a three story town home. I will estimate the move to finish in four hours to five hours with two movers and one truck. So the estimated cost is $7.68296 million' [likely transcription error for $768.29-$960 range at $192/hr]. — gives a time-based range and hourly rate, but personalization is minimal (just mentions floor and destination type, no tie-back to customer's stated prep level or concerns, which were none).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jeline: '$192 per hour for two movers already and everything is included to that gas and truck taxes, insurance. All the wraps and pads, to protect the items being moved and all the tools to disassemble and reassemble the furniture, and here at Einstein. No hidden fees of any time, no credit card fees, no Teres notice, assembly or reassembly fee, no transportation fees, so again, no hidden fees of any type.' — covers no hidden fees and includes all-in framing. Also mentions 'Two and a half is the minimum.' Does NOT state '2.5-hour minimum', '15-minute increments', or 'not a guess' commitment language explicitly.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Jeline moves directly into a weekday-rate discussion: 'Are there any other specials as far as like weekdays? I know we're putting in a Monday as a move-in date...' No 'Does that feel fair?' checkpoint or intentional silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to discount terms, being late, or any guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Never mentioned. No reference to $2,000 coverage, no deductible, or damage guarantee of any kind.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Jeline does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or any closing confirmation. Customer raised no concerns, so there is nothing to close the loop on.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After pricing discussion, Jeline transitions directly to sending an email: 'I'll just send everything to your email and then if ever you're ready to book with us just reply back to that email.'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked directly. Jeline says: 'if ever you're ready to book with us just reply back to that email' — this is soft, conditional, and implies an option to do nothing or wait. No plain 'Would you like our help with your move?' statement.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Jeline: 'We do not require any deposit so there's no risk and securing the spot if ever just let us know and we'll put you on the schedule once you're ready to book with us.' — mentions no-deposit (which implies rate lock) but does not explicitly say 'rate lock' or 'price holds until booking.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Jeline confirms: moving date (October 26th, later refined to Monday), email destination implied but not a phone number or arrival window. No crew size, addresses, or notes for the crew about customer concerns. Only partial details captured.

top_strength: Thorough logistics probing—Jeline systematically gathered property type, floor levels, distances, appliances, special items (65-inch TV), and bed frame details, building a solid foundation for accurate estimation.
coaching_note: Missing the Two Promises section entirely (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), no final concerns check before close, and no explicit closing ask—these three gaps prevented the call from reaching even a baseline passing score despite good discovery work.
